texts.value: The production of the second messenger molecules diacylglycerol (DAG) and inositol 1,4,5-trisphosphate (IP3) is mediated by activated phosphatidylinositol-specific phospholipase C enzymes (PubMed:15331768, PubMed:9188725). Essential for trophoblast and placental development (By similarity). Binds phosphatidylinositol 4,5-bisphosphate (PubMed:15331768, PubMed:7890667, PubMed:9188725)
